description: Procurement for the supply of 2,700,000 vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection (Human) BP, 1000 IU in 10ml (30% soluble 70% Isophane)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the international competitive bidding method for the procurement of 2,700,000 vials of Biphasic Isophane Insulin Injection (Human) BP 1,000 IU in 10ml (30% soluble 70% Isophane), used in the treatment of diabetic patients and two (02) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of said bids, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to                   M.J. Biopharm Private Limited, India (Manufacturer: M.J. Biopharm Pvt Ltd., India), the sole substantially responsive bidder for a sum of USD 4.293 million, inclusive of cost and freight charges, was approved by the Cabinet.
